items.title: A failed week cannot establish a thesis or certify the future
items.premise: checkpointStatus returns evidenced before evaluating phaseGate, season-reckoning consumes all current film in every phase, and overall status becomes established from three receipts regardless of alignedTargets. A pure Week 3 probe with three aligned:false calls reports status established and season-reckoning evidenced.

items.constraint: Evidence remains descriptive and non-causal. Missing or contested proof must be named, not converted into a score or hidden bonus.

L1.recipe: Evaluate phase gates before evidence and require one aligned receipt for established.

L2.recipe: Introduce declared/open/evidenced-contested/evidenced-aligned/unproven checkpoint semantics. Only eligible phase evidence may populate a checkpoint; installing/established derive from eligible aligned evidence plus bounded checkpoint coverage. Preserve exact receipt lineage and update chapter/return copy. Add all-failed, future-gate, mixed, restore, and missing-ID tests.

L3.recipe: L2 plus an inspectable season blueprint showing aligned and contested receipts per checkpoint.
